HBM  整體市場與需求成長 - 大規模擴張：總 HBM 需求預計將大幅成長，到 2027 年達到超過 600 萬 k GB（約 48,618 百萬 Gb）。 - 快速多年軌跡：從 2023 年到 2027 年的歷史與預測成長顯示出陡峭的上升曲線，主要受 AI GPU 與 AI ASIC 部署增加所驅動。  NVIDIA 的市場主導地位 - 最大消費者：NVIDIA
AI 推動光互連需求暴增，磷化銦（InP）成為算力擴張瓶頸。Lumentum 五座 InP 廠出貨仍低於需求逾30%，SemiAnalysis 指出 CPO 用 CW DFB 雷射特別短缺。  核心警告 Lumentum CEO Hurlston 在巴黎 RAISE 高峰會明確表示：InP 短缺將比記憶體危機更嚴重。即使與競爭對手合計，也無法滿足 Nvidia

Ibiden is one of the cleanest asymmetries this earnings season. It reports on Tues.  Most people will watch revenue. We’re watching one line buried in the segment accounts. Why?  Ibiden is the dominant supplier of AI server ABF substrates. Nvidia alone is ~29% of revenue.  In
Kimi K3, The Manos, The Mythos, The Legendos Kimi K3’s architecture: compressed memory, attention across depth, latent expert routing, and serving performance

To me, the limit here is not the system or the AI chips or the interconnect. All those are increasing very fast.  The limit is how much high bandwidth memory you can produce & how close you can stack next to the compute chips.  This applies to AI servers as much as edge AI chips.

Similar to US hyperscalers, the limiting factor to China's AI buildout is also memory chips & advanced packaging/stacking of them.  If 14nm produced DF2000 can match Blackwell in many scenarios, then 7nm capacity isn't the constraint. high speed memory by CXMT is the key!

20GW of AIDC construction/yr would match other figures I've seen which estimated 75-80GW over next 4 yrs.  This also implies other part of supply chain like memory can keep up w/ this much production. It seems like 2026-2027 will have plenty of scaling across the supply chain.
